name: Corn & Soybeans: Backwardation vs Contango Regime Analysis
description: Analyzes backwardation vs contango regimes in corn (ZC) and soybeans (ZS) futures using the front-deferred carry spread. Measures regime frequency and tests whether the current regime predicts the next quarter's (63-day) forward price return. Uses raw carry spread with LiquidityBased rollover and NoAdjustment for meaningful spread values.
source:
# Corn & Soybeans: Backwardation vs Contango Regime Analysis
# Carry spread (front - deferred): positive = backwardation, negative = contango
# Forward 63-day price return tests whether regime predicts next quarter's performance

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
carry = cont.carry
ts = index()

# --- Regime Classification ---
# Backwardation = carry > 0 (front premium), Contango = carry <= 0 (front discount)
is_backwardation = is_valid(carry) and carry > 0
is_contango = is_valid(carry) and carry <= 0

# --- Forward Roll Yield (63-day forward price return) ---
fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(close)

# Regime-filtered forward returns
fwd_backwardation = where(is_backwardation, fwd_63d)
fwd_contango = where(is_contango, fwd_63d)

# Hit rate: 1.0 if forward return positive, 0.0 if not (ternary for correct Mean = hit rate)
hit_backwardation = where(is_backwardation, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_63d) and fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)
hit_contango = where(is_contango, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_63d) and fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)

# --- Regime Flip Detection (for event markers) ---
prev_backwardation = is_backwardation >> 1
prev_contango = is_contango >> 1
flip_to_contango = is_contango and prev_backwardation
flip_to_backwardation = is_backwardation and prev_contango
any_flip = flip_to_contango or flip_to_backwardation
flip_direction = conditional_select(flip_to_backwardation, 1.0, flip_to_contango, -1.0, 0.0)

# --- Carry area fill for regime visualization ---
carry_in_backwardation = where(is_backwardation, carry)
carry_in_contango = where(is_contango, carry)

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT: 1 category, 3 charts + event markers
# ============================================================

# 1. CONTEXT — Carry time series with regime coloring
xy_lines(
    title='Carry Spread: When Is the Market in Backwardation?',
    category='Term Structure Regime',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Backwardation', color=Color.Blue, area=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Contango', color=Color.Gray, area=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Flat')
    ]),
    y_axis_label='Carry Spread ($)',
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(carry_in_backwardation, carry_in_contango))

# 2. PUNCHLINE — Median forward 63d return by regime
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does Backwardation Predict Higher Returns?',
    category='Term Structure Regime',
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Backwardation', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Contango', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(fwd_backwardation, fwd_contango))

# 3. REFERENCE — Summary table: N, Median, Hit Rate, Best, Worst per regime
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Term Structure Regime',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Regime Statistics (63-Day Forward Returns)',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Obs Count', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (>0)', 'Best', 'Worst'],
        col_headers=['Backwardation', 'Contango'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(fwd_backwardation, fwd_contango, fwd_backwardation, fwd_contango, hit_backwardation, hit_contango, fwd_backwardation, fwd_contango, fwd_backwardation, fwd_contango)

# 4. EVENT MAP — Regime flip markers
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Regime Flip',
        icon=Icon.ShuffleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Direction', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(carry, flip_direction, close, any_flip)
